posts.name: Anay Singh
posts.cooked:
Sir I am not able to login to the OPPE VM, i filled the correct SSH key but still it is saying host key verification failed.

I am also attaching the screenshot for the reference, so please resolve this issue. I even did my NPPE questions with same SSH key but now it is showing something else. Also I am not able to access the normal VM for practice of OPPE, it is taking too much time and after sometime it says connection time out.

Please resolve this issue @sayan

Thanks and regards

10003531461155×308 115 KB

posts.name: AARUSHI SINGH AHLAWAT
posts.cooked:
The error message shows that remote host KEY changed since you last configured your passwordless login and accepted the remote host key. This can be resolved by deleting the specific remote host key (complete line specific to host ED25519) in your local .ssh\known_hosts file. After this when you will login first time you will get option to add remote known host. Once accepted, your will be able to connect without password.

I hope this will solve your problem.
